events.label: Sentinel-ravaged future; mutants hunted
events.description: In the near future, the Sentinels - mutant-hunting machines - have all but won: the last X-Men fight in the ruins of a world that learned to fear them.

events.label: Kitty will send Logan's mind to 1973 body
events.description: The survivors' one plan: use Kitty Pryde's phasing power - which can send a mind days back through time - to carry someone's consciousness much further, into their own past body.

events.label: Consciousness projected to 1973 Logan
events.description: Logan volunteers: his healing factor can survive the crossing, and his mind is thrown fifty years upstream into his 1973 self.

events.label: Logan wakes in 1973; must stop Mystique
events.description: Logan wakes in 1973 with the future in his head: he has days to stop the event that starts the whole war - Mystique's assassination of Bolivar Trask.

events.label: Recruit broken young Xavier; spring Magneto
events.description: He finds a wrecked, disillusioned young Charles Xavier hiding in his school's ruins, and needs him - and the imprisoned Magneto - to have any chance.

events.label: Pentagon kitchen rescue (Quicksilver)
events.description: The Pentagon breakout: Quicksilver walks the walls of a kitchen at super-speed, turning a guards' firefight into a ballet, and springs Magneto free.

events.label: Trask unveils anti-mutant tech; Mystique hunts him
events.description: Bolivar Trask sells the Sentinel program on mutant-hunting machines while Mystique - shaping her own war - works her way toward him with murder in mind.

events.label: Prevent public assassination of Trask
events.description: Everything narrows to the Paris summit and the White House: keep Mystique from killing Trask on camera, or the future that made Logan keeps happening.

events.label: Sentinel program cascade averted
events.description: The assassination is stopped - Mystique spares Trask, the Sentinel program loses its pretext, and the dark future begins to come apart.

events.label: Logan wakes in healed future classroom
events.description: Logan wakes where the future was - in the rebuilt school, among students, with faces around him that the other history killed.

events.label: Soft franchise reboot — inconvenient deaths erased
events.description: The restored timeline quietly rewrites the films' earlier losses - the dead alive, the school whole - a fresh page drawn over fifty years.

events.label: Xavier's hope treated as condition for good future
events.description: The principle that changes the future: Xavier, in the end, choosing hope over fear - the decision the whole timeline hangs from.

events.label: Sentinel future war
events.description: The Sentinel war in the ruins - the future the story is trying to unwrite.

events.label: Wolverine mind sent to 1973
events.description: The mind sent fifty years upstream - one consciousness carried across half a century into a younger body.

events.label: Wake in young Logan
events.description: Logan in 1973: sideburns, bad habits, and a mission no one else can remember needing.

events.label: Prevent Trask/Mystique assassination path
events.description: The Paris summit, where the knife was to fall - and instead the future was refused.

events.label: Young Xavier growth
events.description: Young Xavier finding his way back to being the professor - the telepath who lost his gift and rebuilt his faith.

events.label: RFK stadium climax
events.description: The RFK Stadium climax - Magneto rips the stadium from its foundations and flies it around the White House lawn.

events.label: Future war erased
events.description: The future war, unravelling in real time as the past is changed - the Sentinels' victory dissolving mid-battle.

events.label: Mind-travel alters history ripples
events.description: The film's rules: only a mind can cross, the body stays behind, and history is altered by changing people - not by killing them.

ruleEffects.effect: Preventing Trask kill overwrites Sentinel future into classroom peace
Franchise treats as successful branch/reboot of continuity

outcome.summary: Logan wakes among living students; Sentinel future overwritten; soft reboot achieved.
